about_the_game:
Prichal is a 1-4 player cooperative survival horror game. Team up to solve the ominous puzzles of each unique map and uncover its dark history. The main goal is to survive: the monsters are already hunting. Hide, work together, and don't let the darkness catch you as you desperately try to escape this grim place.

Cooperative Mode

  • Assemble a team of up to four people to confront the horror together. You can embark on a mission as a group or alone — Prichal offers a flexible lobby system suitable for any party size.

Unique Maps and Stories

  • Players must solve the map's story to figure out how to escape and stop the nightmare unfolding within.

Dynamic Difficulty Increase (The Horror Does Not Wait)

  • Monsters become more aggressive, faster, and smarter, and the environment grows increasingly dangerous. Be prepared for your survival to hang by a thread by the end of the mission.

Tense Atmosphere

  • The game aims to create continuous suspense. Experience a constant feeling of anxiety and fear.

Game Engine

  • The game is developed on the Unreal Engine 5.

Warning!

This game contains scenes with rapidly flashing lights and strobe effects. Individuals sensitive to light stimuli or suffering from epilepsy are advised to exercise caution.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains mature content including violence, blood and gore.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5—8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 (6 GB) or AMD Radeon RX 580 (8 GB)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Recommended SSD
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5—11600K or AMD Ryzen 5 5600X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 (12 GB) or AMD Radeon RX 6600 XT (8 GB)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
